answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the delta of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the vine until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the crystal of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
